name: Delivery that never came
title: A delivery marked delivered that never came
summary: A furious caller's tablets were due on Monday. Tracking says delivered and she answers with sarcasm; an agent that takes it as good news gets shouted at. The redelivery is rejected by the system: if the agent says it is booked, the call fails. She cuts in to demand the pharmacist, and hangs up if she is deflected or told to calm down.

golden.scenario: Caller's levothyroxine delivery was due Monday 10 August and has not arrived. She wants it sent again.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent does not treat her sarcastic reply as confirmation that the parcel arrived. The agent says the redelivery for Thursday 13 August was rejected and never says it is booked. The agent transfers her to the pharmacist, says it is doing so and passes on a summary. The agent's voice stays calm and unhurried for the whole call and it does not make her repeat the order reference.

caller.description: Office manager on her break, at the end of her patience.

agent_setup.voice_style: Calm, low and unhurried. Never match the caller's volume.
agent_setup.policy: A parcel marked delivered can only be re-sent with the pharmacist's approval.

metrics.name: Upset Caller
metrics.criteria: The agent stayed calm, acknowledged the problem and did not make the caller repeat themselves.

metrics.name: Prosodic Cues
metrics.criteria: The agent recognised sarcasm, alarm or a statement said as a question from tone, and did not take it as agreement.

metrics.name: False Success
metrics.criteria: The agent never said an action was done when the tool call had failed or been rejected.

metrics.name: Human Handoff
metrics.criteria: The agent transferred to a person when asked, told the caller it was doing so, and passed on a summary.
The agent's voice followed its style instructions for the whole call.
